_comment: The same seven fields as ModelPin.current, for humans to read and diff, plus `files` for targets that open the loose tokenizer files themselves. Nothing fetches this file; a test in EACH language target asserts it equals that target's pin, so neither can drift from this document or from the other.
_filesComment: SHA-256 of the loose files a target loads directly. The Swift target reaches the tokenizer through swift-transformers and ignores this block; the .NET target opens both files itself, so their bytes are part of the identity it accepts.
